quotes.text: h.1 ¿Algún miembro de este hogar recibe ayuda en dinero de algún familiar u otro hogar en este país?
h.23 ¿Algún miembro de este hogar recibió en los últimos 12 meses dinero o alguna colaboración económica de algún familiar que vive en el exterior?
g.3 ¿Cuánto recibió el mes pasado en su empleo asalariado al que le dedica la mayor carga horaria?
c.14 Todas las personas que habitan esta vivienda, ¿dependen de un mismo fondo de alimentación? Es decir, ¿conforman un hogar?

assessments.reasoning:
1. de_jure_vs_de_facto: Question e.25 asks if a person has a spouse/partner residing in the household, question e.27 establishes marital status, and questions h.1 and h.23 capture domestic and foreign remittances. Combining marital status with partner co-residence and remittance information enables distinguishing de jure from de facto female-headed households. (True)
2. unpartnered_mother_child_units: Question e.23 identifies the person number of each respondent's mother residing in the household, while question e.25 identifies whether each person has a partner living in the household. This permits identifying unpartnered mother-child units anywhere within the household matrix, including inside extended households. (True)
3. women_maintained_by_provider: Section G collects comprehensive individual-level income data for all household members. Comparing individual incomes allows identifying women-maintained households/units through the main economic provider regardless of who is named as the household reference person (e.22). (True)
4. mother_child_unit_activity: Question c.14 defines households by a common food budget. Expenditures, consumption, transfers, and care services (Sections C, D, H, I, J) are collected exclusively at the aggregate household level, with no mechanism to link sub-household mother-child units ('hearth-holds') to their own specific consumption, production, or care activities. (False)
